reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations

title.narrative: COVID Vaccine Access through EU sharing with Eastern Partnership

description.narrative: With this 35 million assistance package the EU seeks to substantially increase access to vaccines in the Eastern Partnership region amid the global vaccine shortage, facilitating the vaccine sharing by the EU Member States and reimbursing the cost. This assistance complements the EU's support to the COVAX initiative, the world's facility to ensure fair and universal access to COVID-19 vaccines, and work towards an equitable and transparent distribution of vaccines.
